Looping in with proposed technical onboarding plan. High level timeline and owners below — happy to iterate: 

- Week 0 (Prep, owners: Monica (lead), Karthik (tech)): Validate staging access, run sample ingestion, capture token/latency distribution on typical 10k records.
- Week 1 (P0 integration): Implement and test prefix/KV caching for repeated claim headers; run 3 nightly jobs in staging to validate throughput and cost predictability.
- Week 2 (Eval & tuning): Run quality evals on 5k sample cases, adjust quantization and batching per latency SLOs.
- Week 3 (Canary): Canary in production with 10% of nightly volume; monitor costs and false-positive routing to human review.

Owner assignments: Monica (onboarding lead, customer-facing runbook), Karthik (runtime tuning, kernel selection), Soojin (program manager & escalation), Priyom (contract/billing liaison).

Open risks to capture in MAP: data schema drift on incoming exports, EOD window tightness (20–30 minute SLA for nightly job), and potential need for on-prem private deployment if data residency becomes stricter.

Proposed kickoff slots (PT): Jun 9 09:00–10:00, Jun 10 09:30–10:30, Jun 11 08:00–09:00. Elena / Marco — pick any that works. I'll draft a short runbook template for the kickoff and attach to HubSpot.

Cheers,
